## Context / Problem

The eval/calibration library surface excludes activated project code-review criteria. `_code_review_prompt_id` only admits static built-in physical ids and has no repository context (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:187-201`). `calibrate_criterion` maps non-physical ids through the default plan-review namespace and has no code-review membership branch (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:384-421`). CLI dual-registry admission is intentionally owned by dependent child `41e-a0a2-2db4-4847`; this story establishes the resolver/calibration behavior that child consumes.

## Approach

- In `eval_solver.py`, change `_code_review_prompt_id` to accept `repo_root` as an optional keyword argument. Always populate the current built-in physical ids. When `repo_root` is provided, add every logical id returned by `code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)`, mapped with `criterion_prompt_id(logical_id, gate_key="code_review")`.
- Update the actual dispatch guard at `eval_solver.py:279` from `_code_review_prompt_id(prompt_id)` to `_code_review_prompt_id(prompt_id, repo_root=repo_root)` before `_run_code_review_case`; this is the thin vertical path that exercises the widened admission set.
- In `eval.py`, use the existing `calibrate_criterion(..., repo_root=None, ...)` parameter. Select the code-review arm only when `repo_root is not None` and `criterion_id in code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)`. Resolve that arm with `criterion_prompt_id(criterion_id, gate_key="code_review")`; otherwise retain the existing plan-review branch unchanged. Project code-review calibration therefore requires an explicit repository root, while repo-root-absent and plan-review callers keep current behavior.
- In the code-review arm only, catch `EvalError` from `load_eval_spec` and re-raise a located `EvalError` that includes the logical `criterion_id` and preserves the original path/message.
- Author `test_*eval*` functions in `tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py` for every contract below. First prove `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k eval --collect-only` collects the intended tests, then run them RED before production edits.
- Do not update `_criteria_eval` CLI admission here: dependent child `41e` owns the dual-registry/ambiguity guard after this library seam lands.

## Testing

- Happy path: in a synthetic repo with active `project.foo`, `_code_review_prompt_id("code-review-project-foo", repo_root=repo_root)` is admitted and `calibrate_criterion("project.foo", repo_root=repo_root)` runs its code-review fixture through `_run_code_review_case`.
- Mapping edge: inactive project physical ids are rejected, proving logical-to-physical mapping rather than raw comparison.
- Backward compatibility: `_code_review_prompt_id("code-review-tests")` without `repo_root` still admits the built-in; a plan-review criterion still follows the unchanged calibration path.
- Missing spec: active `project.foo` with no eval YAML raises `EvalError` containing both `project.foo` and the located eval-spec path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An activated project code-review criterion resolves and calibrates through the code-review arm; verified by `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k eval`.
- [ ] A plan-review criterion eval path is unchanged; verified by the same `-k eval` selector.
- [ ] `_code_review_prompt_id("code-review-project-foo", repo_root=repo_root)` admits active logical `project.foo` and rejects an inactive project id; verified by the same selector.
- [ ] `_code_review_prompt_id("code-review-tests")` remains admitted without a repository root; verified by the same selector.
- [ ] An active project code-review criterion with no eval spec raises a located `EvalError` whose message contains the logical criterion id; verified by the same selector.
